sloka: एताः सममिदानीं ते वयमात्मा च पातिताः ।ब्रुवाणो ऽपि हितं वाक्यमिष्टो भ्राता विबीषणः ।धृष्टं परुषितो मोहात्त्वया ऽ ऽत्मवधकाङ्क्षिणा ।। ६.११३.१९ ।।
transliteration: etāḥ samamidānīṁ te vayamātmā ca pātitāḥ ।bruvāṇo 'pi hitaṁ vākyamiṣṭo bhrātā vibīṣaṇaḥ ।dhṛṣṭaṁ paruṣito mohāttvayā ' 'tmavadhakāṅkṣiṇā ।। 6.113.19 ।।

translations.english: "Even though good advice was given by your dear brother Vibheeshana, in your delusion evidently you sought your own destruction."
